_readme: Photos and videos for the Path page (one entry per stage) and for the Personal page. The site shows up to three 'featured' items on each stage; 'gallery' items open in the Field notes viewer.

Put media files in assets/media/ and list them here. Item: {"type": "image" or "video", "src": "assets/media/name.jpg", "alt": "what the picture shows", "caption": "optional", "poster": "optional still for a video"}.
Stage keys are generated from the role or degree title in content.json; 'label' is only a reminder for you. Keep the keys as they are.
